messages:
mira: Starting migration MIG-402: apply FK validate + small backfill. Window 02:00-03:00 UTC. will run in phased tenants (sample) first. tagging release notes now.

deploy-bot: preflight checks ok. claiming migration lease. estimated rows to touch: ~1.2M. batch_size=500, concurrency=8. kicking off sample wave (tenants: sample-10pct).

noah: noting read-replica lag for eu-west-1 at ~8s steady, but spiking to 22s in the last 5m. threshold was 15s.

rajiv: hmm, FK validate runs per-tenant and holds a short lock. with replica lag spike that could cause trailing replicas to fall behind which risks lagged reads during rollout. propose reduce concurrency to 4 and batch_size to 200 for eu region.

sre-anna: recommended automatic hold if replica_lag > 18s for >2m. deploy-bot can gate on metric: replication.replica_lag_seconds.max > 18.

ops-runner: deploy-bot gate configured. current sample wave: tenants 0-9999. suggestion: proceed with US tenants only and pause EU until lag recovers.

mira: agree. run US-only sample, pause EU. update rollout plan in release notes: "US sample wave only; EU paused for lag". @product FYI.

deploy-bot: pausing eu-west-1 shards. continuing sample wave on us-east-1/us-west-2.

noah: starting reduced-concurrency override for US sample: running command ->
```bash
kubectl exec -it deploy-bot -- update-migration MIG-402 --concurrency 4 --batch 200 --tenants us-sample
```

deploy-bot: acknowledged. new params applied. wave 1 (us-sample) started.ETA ~12m. progress ping every 120s.

[~8m later]

deploy-bot: wave 1 progress: 41% rows touched, errors: 0, avg p99 write latency: 12ms.

rajiv: good. small note — FK validate has a corner-case where a concurrent delete could cause a transient CHECK violation alert but is safe to retry. set transient_error_retry=3.

ops-runner: applied retry policy. Updated command ->
```bash
update-migration MIG-402 --transient-retries 3
```

mira: question: what are rollback criteria? need explicit thresholds for automated abort and for manual abort.

sre-anna: automated abort if errors > 0.5% of rows in any 60s window OR p99 write latency > 500ms sustained >2m OR replica_lag > 25s. Manual abort if application error rates (5xxs) increase >1% or customer-facing latency SLO breach.

noah: also add safety: if any tenant's backfill time > 3x expected estimate, mark that tenant for manual review and continue others.

deploy-bot: noted. will abort wave if automated criteria hit + post message to this thread.

[~4m later]

deploy-bot: wave 1 complete: 100% sample rows validated, 0 errors, p99 write latency 18ms. EU still paused (replica_lag eu-west-1 = 21s).

mira: great. plan: promote sample to US phased rollout (10% of tenants by hash), hold EU. schedule next check at +30m. update release notes: "MIG-402: US phased rollout started; EU paused due to replica lag"

ops-runner: rolling out 10% by tenant-hash now. command ->
```bash
deploy-bot start-rollout MIG-402 --percent 10 --regions us --stagger 5m
```

deploy-bot: rollout started. first window applied to tenant-hashes 0..99999. next window in 5m. monitor rollouts/throughput.

[~10m later]

deploy-bot: metric alert: eu-west-1 replica_lag spike cleared to 6s.

noah: EU lag recovered. recommend a small safety test: run migration on 1 EU tenant (canary) with concurrency=1 batch=50.

rajiv: agreed. if canary passes, we can unpause EU and continue with 5% staging there.

mira: go for EU canary.

deploy-bot: EU canary started for tenant eu-311. progress: 20% -> logs: "FK_VALIDATE tenant=eu-311 step=apply rows=120 success".

[~3m later]

deploy-bot: EU canary complete, 0 errors, p99 write latency 28ms. unpausing eu rollout at 5% with concurrency 2.

ops-runner: applied eu params. starting 5% phased rollout.

mira: final notes: add a post-mortem checkpoint in 24h to verify no late regressions. update release notes and tag @oncall-sre. :white_check_mark:

sre-anna: tagging oncall. will run replication-consistency sweep in 2h and post results.

rajiv: logging note: added explicit migration id to logs for easier correlation: MIG-402 -> trace_id. sample log ->
```text
2026-06-12T02:21:45Z MIG-402 trace=abc123 tenant=us-42 step=validate rows=320 duration_ms=45
```

mira: thanks all. closing thread.
